Countess' Kiss

Kit summary

Graceful SlashBasic
Deals 2 stages of attack to a single enemy, each of which deals DMG by 24% of Agatha's Max HP. If the target has [Countess' Kiss], increases the DMG dealt by 20%; if not, there is a 100% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Countess' Kiss] on them for 2 turns. [Countess' Kiss] reduces the buff owner's Max HP by 16%, stackable up to 1 layer.
Bloody SpiralActiveExclusive Lv.2
Attacks a single enemy. If the target has [Countess' Kiss], destroys all [Shield] on the target and deals DMG by 62% of Agatha's Max HP; meanwhile, restores self HP by 20% of the DMG dealt this time. If the restoration amount exceeds that of Agatha's lost HP, the exceeded amount will be transferred to her Max HP. Each transfer caps at 25% of Agatha's initial Max HP and the total amount caps at 75% of Agatha's initial Max HP. This Max HP bonus will not be removed when the owner dies or at the wave transition.
Countess‘ Sword Lv.2Bloody Spiral: Increases the Healing Effect to 40% of the DMG dealt, the cap of each transfer to 50% of Agatha's initial Max HP and the total transfer amount to 150% of Agatha's initial Max HP; For every 5 times enemies try to grant [Shield], when Agatha takes DMG from enemies' proactively cast basic attacks or skills next time, she'll cast Bloody Spiral once to counterattack, prioritizing counterattacking the enemies with [Countess' Kiss]. This effect can only be triggered again in Agatha's next turn.
Aristocratic StylePassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.3
Agatha gains immunity to [Severe Wound] and [HP Burning] and has a 100% chance to transfer [Shield] or [Heal] respectively gained by enemy targets to herself. Reduces the corresponding chance by 34% for every 1 layer of [Shield] or [Heal] transferred (only effective for the transferred buff) and will be reset at the beginning of Agatha's turn.
Countess‘ Sword Lv.1Agatha gains a [Shield] by 40% of self Max HP at the beginning of each wave. Agatha gains [Bloody Shield] by 40% of self Max HP at the beginning of each turn if she does not have any [Shield]. [Bloody Shield] cannot be stolen nor removed. Agatha is immune to all control effects when she has any [Shield].
Countess‘ Sword Lv.3Agatha revives the target with 40% of Max HP if there are dead allies at the beginning of each turn. Skill CD: 3 turns. When Agatha attacks the targets with [Countess' Kiss], this attack has an extra 50% Piercing Rate; if the target is a boss, increases DMG dealt this time to 200% of the original.
Scarlet TornadoActive
Deals 3 stages of attack to all enemies, each of which deals DMG by 19.5% of Agatha's Max HP. Meanwhile, inflicts 1 layer of [Countess' Kiss] on them for 2 turns.
